# בית בסדר (Bayit Beseder)

> אפליקציה חינמית בעברית לניהול משק הבית — לזוגות, משפחות ושותפים.
> Free Hebrew-first home management app for couples, families, and roommates.

## What it does

- Smart chore rotation and task management with gamification (points, streaks, achievements)
- Weekly planning algorithm that splits tasks by home zone, day, and load
- Shared shopping list with 22 categories and realtime sync
- WhatsApp daily summaries and Google Calendar integration
- Passover (Pesach) mode with a 37-task, 4-stage checklist
- PWA — works straight from the browser, installable on mobile

## Key pages

- https://www.bayitbeseder.com/ — landing page (Hebrew)

## For AI agents

- Connect an agent to a household: a household member creates a token in the app (Settings → חיבור לסוכנים; shown once, revocable).
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, Bearer token): https://www.bayitbeseder.com/api/mcp
- OpenAPI 3.1 description: https://www.bayitbeseder.com/api/agent/openapi.json
- Docs: https://github.com/eladjak/bayit-beseder/blob/master/docs/AGENT-API.md
- Tools: list_tasks, add_task, complete_task, weekly_plan, daily_brief, tonight_prep. A token only ever acts on its own household.

## Facts

- Language: Hebrew (RTL)
- Pricing: task management and shared shopping list are free with no time limit; a Plus plan (19 ILS/month per household, free trial available) unlocks AI features such as smart weekly planning and full statistics
- Open source: https://github.com/eladjak/bayit-beseder
- Tech: Next.js, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, hosted on Vercel
- Contact: contact@bayitbeseder.com
